clue.text: Dirty game with one vehicle leading another is a seaside attraction

parts.note: dirty clothes or hands can be called black
pool is a cue game played on a table
a vehicle that pulls another along behind it is a tower, one that tows

explanation.surface: A grubby game and a little convoy of vehicles somehow add up to a day out by the sea.
explanation.walkthrough: BLACKPOOL TOWER is the landmark iron tower on the seafront at Blackpool, a resort town in north-west England.
explanation.definitionFit: The tower is a famous tourist landmark in an English resort town by the sea.

clue.text: Accommodation costing more? Respite wanted

parts.note: a let is a rented property, somewhere to live
when prices rise they are said to be up

explanation.surface: A tenant facing a rent rise longs for some relief.
explanation.definitionFit: A pause or easing off in something unpleasant is a respite, a let-up.

clue.text: Upset Catholic is repeatedly creating emergency

indicators.note: in a down clue, upset turns the abbreviation for Catholic upside down so it reads the other way

parts.note: RC is the usual abbreviation for Roman Catholic

indicators.note: repeatedly says the little word is is used twice over

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A distressed Catholic keeps causing an emergency.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Upset' turns RC into CR; 'repeatedly' gives IS twice.
explanation.definitionFit: A crisis is a moment of acute danger or difficulty, an emergency.

clue.text: Insincere folk sore when grabbed by newspaper folk endlessly

indicators.note: being grabbed by something puts the word for sore inside the shortened press
endlessly means the last letter of the word for journalists is dropped

parts.note: journalists collectively are the press
a sore spot is tender

explanation.surface: Fake people get annoyed when reporters seize on them.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sore' reads as a feeling, but it is tender to the touch; 'endlessly' trims the press before 'grabbed by' encloses that word.
explanation.definitionFit: Those who feign or make false claims are pretenders, people who are not genuine.

clue.text: River to flow gently, as one might say

indicators.note: as one might say signals that the word is spoken and a sound-alike is entered

parts.note: to ooze is to seep or flow slowly

explanation.surface: A river described as one that trickles slowly along.
explanation.walkthrough: The Ouse is the name of several English rivers, including the one through York.
explanation.definitionFit: The Ouse is a watercourse in England, so it is an example of a river.

clue.text: Start of the warm weather and friend abroad is in natural disaster

indicators.note: start of picks just the opening letter of the word the

parts.note: sunshine, or sun, is warm weather
ami is French for friend

explanation.surface: The arrival of warm weather and a foreign friend coincides with a catastrophe.
explanation.definitionFit: A huge sea wave caused by an earthquake is a catastrophe of nature.

clue.text: Small vehicle engineer has travelled in last to arrive

indicators.note: in says the word for travelled is placed inside the engineer's name

parts.note: James Watt was the Scottish engineer who improved the steam engine
having travelled away, one has gone

indicators.note: last to picks the final letter of arrive

explanation.surface: An engineer drives up in a little cart, the final one to turn up.
explanation.definitionFit: A wagonette is a light four-wheeled horse-drawn carriage, a small conveyance.

clue.text: Delaware always has this zone of limited access

parts.note: the letters AREA sit restricted inside the words Delaware always, so those words hold a confined stretch of area

explanation.surface: An American state supposedly always containing an off-limits zone.
explanation.walkthrough: Look at the letters: delawARE Always holds AREA, an area restricted within the two words.
explanation.definitionFit: A place where entry is controlled or forbidden is a zone where access is limited.

clue.text: A nude permitted to roam without prior consideration

indicators.note: to roam is to wander freely, so these letters wander into a new order

explanation.surface: A naked person allowed to wander about, done on impulse.
explanation.definitionFit: Something done with no planning beforehand is spontaneous, not thought out in advance.

clue.text: Elegance of ten saints in new guise

indicators.note: in new guise means the letters appear in a fresh arrangement

explanation.surface: Ten holy figures dressed up stylishly in new outfits.
explanation.definitionFit: Natty means smart and neat in dress, so the quality of being natty is stylishness.

clue.text: Desires to move briskly ahead, first to last

indicators.note: first to last says the opening letter of the word is shifted to the end

parts.note: to surge is to rush forward powerfully

explanation.surface: Someone longing to dash forward from the front to the back.
explanation.definitionFit: Strong wishes or impulses are cravings, the same sense as desires.

clue.text: Agent with hat is a treacherous person

parts.note: a rep, short for representative, is a sales agent
tile is old slang for a hat

explanation.surface: A salesman in a hat turns out to be a traitor.
explanation.definitionFit: A sly, untrustworthy person is called a snake or a cold-blooded creature.

clue.text: Old money for a man who got to hide

definitions.meaning: a sixpence coin in pre-decimal British currency was nicknamed this

definitions.text: a man who got to hide
definitions.meaning: one who works animal skins into leather; got to hide puns on getting to work on a hide

explanation.surface: Cash for a man desperate to go into hiding.
explanation.walkthrough: A tanner was a sixpenny piece in British money before 1971.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses fit: a slang name for a sixpence coin, and a worker who cures animal skins.

clue.text: Fleet deployed with haste — such must come out at night

definitions.text: such must come out at night

indicators.note: deployed means spread out and arranged, so the letters are redeployed in a new order

explanation.surface: Ships sent out in a hurry, apparently on night manoeuvres.
explanation.definitionFit: Dentures are removed before bed, so they must come out each night.

clue.text: Think to entertain, bringing out article

indicators.note: bringing out means a letter is taken away from the word for entertain

parts.note: to amuse is to entertain
a is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: Pondering how to amuse people by producing a piece of writing.
explanation.definitionFit: To muse is to ponder or reflect, a synonym for think.

clue.text: Like some music? My, Chopin's fantastic!

indicators.note: fantastic means wild and fanciful, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: the composer's name with its s gives the letters CHOPINS

explanation.surface: A listener exclaims in delight at a Chopin piece.
explanation.definitionFit: Music written for a full orchestra in the form of a symphony is described this way.

clue.text: Visionary cities laid out

indicators.note: out here means set out differently, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Towns planned by someone with grand dreams.
explanation.definitionFit: A visionary person pursues lofty ideals, so is dreamy and high-minded.

clue.text: Mother meeting request, got up in something pink and fragrant

parts.note: a dam is the mother of an animal
to ask is to request
rose is the past tense of rise, to get up

explanation.surface: A mother answering a plea rises dressed in something pink and scented.
explanation.definitionFit: This old rose variety has fragrant pink flowers prized for attar of roses.

clue.text: Positions of saints placed on the outside of brown church

indicators.note: placed on the outside of says the saints abbreviation surrounds the other letters

parts.note: S is the abbreviation for saint, so two of them give SS
tan is a light brown colour
CE stands for the Church of England

explanation.surface: Statues of saints arranged around a brown church building.
explanation.definitionFit: Stances are ways of standing or attitudes taken, so they are positions.

clue.text: Yield from what gardener puts down being reported

indicators.note: being reported means the word is heard, so a sound-alike is entered

parts.note: a gardener sows seed in the ground

explanation.surface: Getting a crop from the stuff the gardener sows, according to reports.
explanation.definitionFit: To cede is to give up or surrender ground, which is to yield.

clue.text: Plant in soil initially clean

indicators.note: initially picks the first letter of the word soil

parts.note: to purge is to cleanse thoroughly

explanation.surface: A plant set in earth that has first been cleaned.
explanation.definitionFit: Spurge is a plant of the euphorbia family with milky sap.

clue.text: Capital city getting hit — what river floods it?

indicators.note: floods says the letters flow into the middle of the word for hit

parts.note: to tan someone's hide is to beat them
eh is a way of saying what as a question

explanation.surface: A capital city under attack asks which river is flooding it.
explanation.definitionFit: Tehran is the seat of government of Iran, its principal city.

clue.text: A moggy set about eating very good old starchy food

indicators.note: eating means the outer letters swallow the ones inside
set about means turned round, so the letters run backwards

parts.note: moggy is British slang for a cat
pi, short for pious, means very good

explanation.surface: A cat is set upon while eating some starchy old pudding.
explanation.walkthrough: 'set about' turns ACAT into TACA, and 'eating' puts PIO inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Tapioca is a starch from cassava root, used in milk puddings.

clue.text: Soldiers on a little path that goes round

indicators.note: in a down clue, on means placed above the following piece

parts.note: OR, other ranks, are soldiers who are not officers
a bit is a little

explanation.surface: Troops marching on a short circular track.
explanation.definitionFit: The curved course of a planet or satellite around another body circles round.

clue.text: One sort of queen or another entertained by character in Athens

indicators.note: entertained by means the other queen is taken in by the Greek letter

parts.note: pi is a letter of the Greek alphabet
another queen: ER, Elizabeth Regina

explanation.surface: Two queens are hosted by someone in Greece.
explanation.walkthrough: A peri is a fairy of Persian myth; 'queen', like 'fairy', is slang for an effeminate man, hence 'one sort'.
explanation.definitionFit: A peri is a Persian fairy, and fairy and queen are interchangeable slang, so it is one kind.

clue.text: Medicine is key

definitions.meaning: a restorative drink or remedy that boosts health
in music, the keynote or home note of a key

explanation.surface: Medicine is essential.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses hold: a pick-me-up remedy, and the first note of a scale that names its key.

clue.text: Odious administrator with competence to restrict worker ultimately

indicators.note: to restrict means the two pieces hem a letter in between them

parts.note: an exec is an executive, an administrator
having competence, one is able

indicators.note: ultimately picks the final letter of worker

explanation.surface: A hateful manager uses ability to keep the staff in check.
explanation.definitionFit: Execrable means extremely bad or detestable, a close synonym of odious.

clue.text: This addict — he, we suspect, lives very dangerously

indicators.note: suspect as an adjective means dubious, so the letters are not to be trusted in their order

explanation.surface: We suspect this addict is living on the edge.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom for taking deadly risks means flirting with mortality.
